표지 - 보고 기간·보고자·배포 대상을 고정 위치에 둔다. 매주 덱을 복: Cover - period, reporter and distribution in fixed positions. Copy the deck each week and change only dates and numbers. Writing rules (research 04 · 03): titles are conclusions (no category titles like 'Status' or 'Next Steps'). Numbers come with a comparison baseline (plan · last week), a named owner and a deadline. Bad news (misses · delays · risks) gets the same weight as results, paired with a response. Keep the same layout every issue so only the differences stand out.
이번 주 결론 - 일정은 정상, 성능 목표 1건 미달: This week's conclusion - schedule on track, one performance target missed

첫 장에 결론 - 판정과 숫자를 먼저 보여 주고, 아래 세 줄로 이유를: Conclusion on the first slide - verdict and numbers first, reasons in three lines below. Status is shown in color plus text (normal · caution · risk).
